observations: A framed photovoltaic panel leans against a concrete wall with the cell side facing the camera.
The panel has a silver frame, dark rectangular cells in a grid, and a white back sheet visible along the right edge.
A junction box with black and red cables is mounted on the back of the panel.
A watermark reads "DOMINIC SOLAR ENERGY" and "POSTED ON JIJI".
No brand label, model number, wattage, or specification sticker is legible on the panel in the photo.
